release_notes: Fixed: Intercepting streams in Landing+Offer and Cloaking schemes now correctly resolve landing & offer URLs without raising 'URL not found'. Fixed: Refined prefetch detection to prevent false-positive 'Prefetch ignored' blocks on VPN and mobile browser navigations. Added: Landing-to-Offer transition metrics (LP Clicks & LP CTR) in Landings analytics. Added: Cloudflare Turnstile anti-bot verification support. Added: Direct stream filter editing without deleting/re-creating filter items in Campaign Editor.
